celltype_defs.name: Open Ground
celltype_defs.description: Exposed, with nowhere to stand out of sight.

encounters.title: The Crossing
encounters.description: Someone left in a hurry, and left something behind.

choices.label: Follow them
choices.result: You learn where they went, and lose time doing it.

choices.label: Take what they left
choices.result: It is useful, and someone will want it back.

celltype_defs.name: Shelter
celltype_defs.description: Walls, a roof, and no clear view out.

encounters.title: Already Occupied
encounters.description: The lights are on and the door is unlocked.
encounters.resolved_description: The room sits empty and quiet.

choices.label: Announce yourself
choices.result: You are let in warily, and told something useful.

choices.label: Slip in quietly
choices.result: You find what you need, and are noticed leaving.

celltype_defs.name: Passage
celltype_defs.description: A route through, too narrow to turn back in.

encounters.title: Blocked Passage
encounters.description: Something has come down across the way ahead.
encounters.resolved_description: The way ahead is clear again.

choices.label: Force a way through
choices.result: You get through, and it costs you.

choices.label: Find another way
choices.result: The detour is long but uneventful.

celltype_defs.name: High Ground
celltype_defs.description: Above everything else, and visible from all of it.

encounters.title: The Vantage
encounters.description: From here you can see how much of this place is left.
encounters.resolved_description: You have already read this view.

choices.label: Study it carefully
choices.result: You understand the layout, and lose the light doing it.

choices.label: Move on quickly
choices.result: You keep your pace and learn little.

celltype_defs.name: Landmark
celltype_defs.description: The thing everyone here navigates by.

encounters.title: Someone Was Here
encounters.description: A mark has been left deliberately, and recently.
encounters.resolved_description: The mark has been wiped away.

choices.label: Work out what it means
choices.result: It is a warning, and it is about you.

choices.label: Erase it
choices.result: Whoever it was meant for will never see it.
